custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the boundary between the metal blade and the black handle. In many AI generations, this area suffers from 'melting' where the materials blend incorrectly. Also, evaluate if the meat looks like real biological tissue or synthetic plastic. The background text should be flagged as an artifact unless it is a clear, legible brand logo.
